t: Added support for modeled exception fields when adding errors to a client stub. Implements boto/boto3`#3178 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/3178>`__.
Added the ability to add items to response metadata with the stubber.
This change makes the error handling more verbose in the case where  a stubbed method has been called, but the Stubber is not expecting a call.
Add ability to specify expected params when using `add_client_error` (`#1025 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/1025>`__)
Fix regression in comparing multiple expected parameters
Allow certain paramters to be ignored by specifying stub.ANY. Resolves `#931 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/931>`__
Allow adding additional keys to the service error response.
